sourceFile: 31. BRS-161016 Report TEST compare hearing C2 and E2 2024.04.22_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because it misstates the comparison and captures only a partial C2 result instead of the C2 versus E2 hearing validation.
issues: Primary changed factor should be C2 Hearing vs E2 Hearing, not unspecified baseline vs C2.
Outcome metric is mislabeled as sample size text rather than hearing NG/OK/NG-rate results.
Only one C2 data row is captured; E2 comparison data and other result sections are missing.
Subgroup key appears taken from one worker/machine row and is not a valid case-level grouping.
Evidence omits key table headers and likely data rows needed to support the comparison.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as C2 Hearing versus E2 Hearing using rows that define the test comparison.
Extract paired C2 and E2 OK, NG touch, NG noise, total NG, and NG-rate results by row.
Preserve row-level keys such as date, worker name, machine code, sample type, and recheck group.
Include GE recheck as same validation context or separate outcome only if it compares the same NG samples.
Cite table headers and each supporting data row for every reported metric.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations prove source existence but are insufficient for final comparative evidence.
